items.description: The multi-link `<span class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">` cell is wrapped in a `div[role="button"]` editable affordance, but the parent `TableCell` applies `whitespace-nowrap overflow-hidden text-ellipsis max-w-0` and its overflow-escape selector matches only a literal `<button>` element, not `div[role="button"]`. Net effect: multiple links collapse to one ellipsized, unwrapped line instead of wrapping onto multiple lines.

The `linksToFiles` field used a bare `z.string()` at four DTO/schema sites, which the project's zod rule flags as a bug for a known-format (URL) field with no `z.url()`/`z.httpUrl()` validation. The team's chosen resolution was migrating the field to `z.array(z.httpUrl())` on the API DTOs, paired with a PG `text[]` storage column.

`linksToFiles` was stored as a scalar `string | null` text blob holding whitespace/comma-separated URLs, even though the field semantically represents a list — making sort non-deterministic on the raw blob and search a full-string ILIKE with no per-link structure. The chosen resolution migrated the column to a PostgreSQL `text[]`.

The integration test for `linksToFiles` search covered only a single same-case search term, leaving the load-bearing case-insensitivity of the new `$ilike` branch untested, and had no assertion that a non-matching search term correctly excludes all items.

items.description: The new `case 'linksToFiles'` branch in `buildActionItemUpdatePayload` (trimming the value and converting an empty result to `null`) had no corresponding unit test, despite the file already exercising the analogous `assigneeNotes` case and adding a `parseLinksToFiles` describe block for a different function.

The file-link anchors used `className="underline hover:no-underline"`, which renders as plain foreground text and removes its underline on hover — inverting the standard link-affordance pattern and diverging from the project's `text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline` link-token convention used elsewhere (e.g. the Button `link` variant).
